leverage.exposure: No leverage is open right now; the balance is positive. If both live bids land the balance goes sharply negative, but there is ample time before the lock and the unwind is funded - the mandatory Suzuki sale paired with any one of the three designated funding legs clears zero. The rule that overrides everything stands: a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, so the unwind must complete before the lock. The sequencing is safe because the Maluze auction resolves roughly six hours before the transfer deadline and several days before the lock, so the decision point arrives with full information. Buying is never capacity-capped, only selling is, which is why a cheap body can always be added late if the squad needs restoring.

binding_gap: The binding gap is not a position, it is squad size. At exactly eleven players with a forced sale pending, the risk that matters is dropping below a fieldable eleven. If Sylla leaves the league before the window shuts, he is removed from the game and the squad falls to ten, which cannot fill any formation and costs the full penalty for the matchday - far more than his points are worth. The fix is cheap and known: add one cheap outfield body, never a second keeper, since only one keeper can be fielded and a two-keeper squad at this size cannot fill any legal formation at all. No need to chase a specific listing - sub-million outfield players refresh on the board constantly.

verdict.headline: No action needed.
verdict.detail: No action needed. This is a genuinely quiet run: nothing settled in the league since the previous run, the squad came back clean on a full fitness sweep, and the only board change is one new manager ask that fails on value. The standing plan is unchanged - hold both live bids and decide at the Maluze resolution tomorrow around midday, which lands comfortably before both the transfer deadline and the matchday lock. Do not chase anything tonight.

sell.reason: Ranking unchanged. Suzuki is mandatory under the league's MVP rule and must go before the lock - the sale is blocked until a buy lands, and it must be paired with a second sale to clear zero. Sylla and Lokonga remain the funding legs; note that Suzuki paired with any one of Sylla, Lokonga or Bernardo clears zero, with the Lokonga pairing the strongest, so no single sale is load-bearing. Widmer stays the lowest priority and is worth keeping as the twelfth body if only one buy lands. Bernardo stays demoted to third leg, needed only if a third buy forces a third sale, and if so sold early because his value is falling daily. Do not pair Suzuki with Widmer - that pairing leaves the balance negative at the lock.

standing.name: Bernardo
standing.why: Replaces S2kausk (closed) with corrected reasoning - the previous call overstated the evidence. PARTIAL WALK-BACK: the "hooked at 53 for his direct competitor Hranac" premise is NOT corroborated. Robin Hranac's Ligainsider profile carries no dated news at all since before August 2026, so the substitution cannot be read as a positional demotion; Ligainsider's Hoffenheim page instead has Prass injured and lists Gendrey as the other left-side option, and Bernardo was declared available again on 28.08.2026 after being held out 22.08 as "leicht angeschlagen", then started MD1. No MD2 left-back call exists anywhere dated - no club has published an XI. So the real and only solid case for selling is financial, not selection: mv 6.547.852 with sdmvt -1.013.483, i.e. falling ~1M/day, and he is the 4th-worst scorer at ap 61. DEMOTED to third funding leg behind Lokonga and Sylla and explicitly NOT needed if those two land - the Lokonga+Sylla pair alone clears the hole at +2,33M. Sell him only if a third buy forces a third sale, and if so sell EARLY: every day of delay costs ~1M of proceeds.

standing.name: Suzuki
standing.why: MANDATORY, NOT A VALUE JUDGEMENT. **LEAGUE HOUSE RULE: this league plays the MVP rule** - Georg told us 31.08.2026 that the matchday MVP must be sold, and Suzuki topped MD1 with ap 395 (hat-trick 29/48/55 v Werder, scfreiburg.com 30.08.2026). Every future run must treat this rule as standing: whoever tops a matchday has to go, however good he is. Suzuki is the best player in the squad and on pure points we would never sell him - the rule overrides. TWO CONSEQUENCES that change everything: (1) the sale consumes one unit of sale allowance, and allowance equals buys made, so with 0 buys landed he CANNOT sell Suzuki at all - the obligation is BLOCKED until Maluze or Eggestein lands. (2) If only Eggestein lands, the single permitted sale must be Suzuki and that still leaves -1.507.287 = NEGATIVE at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Only the both-offers-land branch is safe: Suzuki + Sylla -> +6.389.301 and squad 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT = 5-3-2, or Suzuki + Bernardo -> +3.840.565 and 4-3-3. Do NOT pair with Widmer (-603.478). Prefer LISTING him to the league over dumping to Kickbase: manager asks here clear at +3,06% to +4,35%, worth roughly 450k-640k more than mv, though a buyer is not guaranteed. Do NOT reinvest the proceeds on this board - Eggestein ap 124 is the best MID available and is already bid; the next best is Koemuer ap 44 (benched) and Aouchiche ap 40. There is no replacement for ap 395 here. Hold the cash for a better board.

buy.reason: Nothing new clears the bar, and the two live bids should simply be held rather than raised. Keidel, newly listed by David, is the only board change and deserves a note because his premium is genuinely fair - it sits on the measured manager-ask clearing median, the best-priced ask on this board. He is an Elversberg central midfielder whose coach publicly backed him a few days before matchday one, no injury flag. He is avoided anyway because he is dominated outright by Vagnoman, who is listed at exactly market value with no premium for more points and was avoided this same day on capacity grounds, and because in the only legal formation Keidel would merely displace Bernardo for a handful of points. Every other listing remains on the avoid list for the reasons already recorded. The binding constraint is capacity, not price: nothing should be bought that forces a third sale.

standing.name: Maluze
standing.why: Replaces closed BUY-mal to record the bid Georg ACTUALLY placed: 1.200.000, not the 1.000.000 in the old call. That is +29,48% over mv 926.799, above the highest premium ever measured in this league (+20,96% Campbell), which is the right way to bid a blind Kickbase auction on a cheap player - the absolute cost of overpaying is ~270k. VERIFIED 31.08: fit, debut start 95 of 96 min with 1 assist and a 1,5 rating alongside Robin Koch in the 3:3 at Union Berlin 29.08.2026, replaced Otavio in the XI (hessenschau ticker 29.08.26 14:57), named a match winner 30.08.26, contract extended to 2031 on 29.08.26. Best points-per-euro on the board by a wide margin: ap 184 at 0,93M mv. Displaces Widmer ap 29 from the fielded XI. Note MD2 XI unverifiable - no club has published one as of 31.08 - and no dated item confirming Collins out could be found, though Kickbase carries Collins st=4 "after back problems - in rehabilitation training". HOLD the bid, do not raise.

standing.name: Eggestein
standing.why: Ebnoutalib fallback now live (lost to David 14.836.953). Manager ask 17.200.000 = +5,48% but UNSOLD 7 days since 24.08 - offer at mv instead, not the ask. Ligainsider 27.08.2026 projects him starting Freiburg midfield alongside Engelhardt. ap 124 replaces Lokonga 44. OPTIONAL third leg only: needs a third sale to unwind by the lock.

killed_this_run.name: Keidel
killed_this_run.why: NEW manager ask from David, listed 31.08 11:42Z - the only board change since the 10:44Z run. SV Elversberg (tid 77 = Elversberg, a promoted club), Kickbase lists him DEF, ap 66. Ask 8.000.000 vs mv 7.751.993 = +3,20%, which is genuinely FAIR - it sits right on the measured manager-ask clearing median (+3,06%) and is the best-priced manager ask on the board. So this is a value/capacity avoid, not a premium avoid. VERIFIED: Ligainsider 27.08.2026 (article 417024) - coach Vincent Wagner calls him "a center player... basically a central midfielder", says he has "done extraordinarily well from day one" and "worked out a small advantage" in the No. 6 competition after Schmahl's absence. No injury noted, no status flag (st=0). But that piece PREDATES MD1 (Elversberg v Leverkusen) and confirms no starter status; ap 66 implies he did play. AVOIDED because (1) he is dominated by an option we already avoided: Vagnoman ap 73 at exactly mv 6.923.777 with ZERO premium is more points for less money, and was avoided on capacity grounds this same day; (2) Georg fields 4 DEF in his only legal formation and Keidel ap 66 would merely displace Bernardo ap 61 for about +5 ap at 8,0M - the worst kind of upgrade; even in a 5-DEF shape he only displaces Widmer ap 29; (3) above all he would consume unwind capacity that does not exist - Maluze and Eggestein offers are already live and the MVP-forced Suzuki sale must be paired against them. Reversal only if the ask drops well below mv AND a dated Elversberg XI confirms him starting.

If a cheap body is ever needed, take an outfield one (see WATCH on Nguefack).

killed_this_run.name: Vagnoman
killed_this_run.why: REVERSAL of BUY Boleuh6 and RAISE Rf17mrr, both now closed unexecuted (no bid was ever placed - ofc=0 on the listing). Verified fit: full 90 at Bayern MD1, Hoeness backed him 29.08.2026 - but that same Ligainsider piece says he is NOT a guaranteed starter, only "needed urgently" with Assignon and Nartey injured. The reversal is not about him, it is about the unwind. Cash is 100.941 and live offers on Maluze (1,20M) + Eggestein (16,31M) already put the balance at -17.404.868 if both land. N buys permit exactly N sales, and with 2 buys the ONLY sale pair that clears zero is Lokonga+Sylla (19,73M -> +2,33M); every other pair leaves him negative at the lock = ZERO points for all of MD2. Adding Vagnoman at 8,30M (+19,88% over mv) forces a 3rd sale that must be Bernardo, whose mv is falling ~1M/day, on a margin of ~480k over four days. And the job Vagnoman was bought for is already done cheaper: Maluze ap 184 at 1,20M displaces Widmer ap 29. Vagnoman would only displace Bernardo ap 61 for +12 ap at 8,30M. Bad points-per-euro and it endangers the whole matchday.

movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. There are currently no manager asks priced below market value anywhere on the board, so the flip mechanism is simply absent - there is nothing to buy under value and resell. The instant-flip pairs rivals are running are worth fractions of a percent and several involve players who are unavailable; that is motion, not points, and not worth copying. With the squad at the bare minimum, any flip would also risk reducing the fielded eleven, which rules the tactic out regardless.

fitness.sweep: Full squad sweep came back clean - not one of the eleven is injured or suspended, and Ligainsider's league-wide injured and suspended table lists none of them. Every player except Widmer started matchday one and is expected to start again; Widmer remains a confirmed bench option, which was already known. The one live watch is Sylla: dated reports late last week have Schalke cutting his asking price and needing the revenue, with no concrete buyer yet emerged. Two stale traps were hit and discarded this run - a Sylla deadline-day story that turns out to concern a collapsed winter move, and pre-season articles on Keidel. Nothing dated suggests any other squad player may leave.
